entries.title: Liquid Body Fail
entries.text: The subject attempts liquid dance, trying to move like water, body flowing in undulating waves, movements smooth for three seconds then completely glitching, freezing, restarting the liquid loop.

entries.title: Freeze Tag Champion
entries.text: The subject freezes in an impossible mid-dance pose — one leg up, arms at odd angles — holds it shaking violently, then slowly crumbles in stages like a condemned building, each section falling separately.

entries.title: Six-Step Stumble
entries.text: The subject attempts breakdance six-step footwork on the ground, legs cycling in the pattern, moving in the wrong direction, circling away from starting point, still cycling legs as they disappear offscreen.

entries.title: Invisible Mosh Pit
entries.text: The subject violently moshes alone, thrashing wildly, headbanging, shoving invisible people, stumbling and recovering with chaotic drunken energy, screaming silently at the ceiling.

entries.title: Anarchist Pogo
entries.text: The subject jumps erratically in place in chaotic pogo dance, fists pumping, mouth open screaming at the sky, pure drunken rage and joy alternating with each landing.

entries.title: Thrash Spiral
entries.text: The subject spins in tight circles while headbanging violently, hair whipping, arms flailing, getting dizzy, stumbling outward in an expanding spiral, crashing, returning to spin more.

entries.title: Punk Kick Line
entries.text: The subject kicks legs high in chaotic can-can style, alternating legs faster and faster, losing rhythm, kicking randomly, falling but still kicking aggressively from the ground.

entries.title: Wall of Death Solo
entries.text: The subject charges forward aggressively at nothing, crashes into an invisible wall of people, bounces back hard, shakes it off, charges again from a different angle with full commitment.

entries.title: Fury Stomp
entries.text: The subject stomps the ground repeatedly with increasing rage, jumping and landing hard, shaking fists at the sky, primal scream energy, exhausting themselves, collapsing, stomping again.

entries.title: Circle Pit Alone
entries.text: The subject runs in circles at full speed, pushing off invisible moshers, accelerating until losing control, wiping out completely, getting up immediately to run again without missing a beat.

entries.title: Stage Dive to Nothing
entries.text: The subject climbs an invisible stage, poses dramatically, leaps forward with arms spread expecting to be caught, crashes to ground, gets up triumphantly, climbs again, dives again without hesitation.

entries.title: Hardcore Tantrum
entries.text: The subject throws a full body tantrum, dropping to knees, pounding the ground, rolling around, screaming silently, jumping up to thrash arms wildly, collapsing again with total conviction.

entries.title: Two-Step Chaos
entries.text: The subject does aggressive hardcore two-step, swinging arms in wide arcs, kicking out randomly, spinning with fists extended, almost punching themselves in the face repeatedly.

entries.title: Windmill Crash
entries.text: The subject swings both arms simultaneously in giant windmill circles, accelerating uncontrollably, spinning the whole body, taking flight briefly, crashing into an invisible drum kit with total commitment.

entries.title: Pit Surfer
entries.text: The subject crowd surfs over invisible hands, riding the nonexistent crowd horizontally, paddling arms to stay afloat, slowly sinking through the imaginary crowd to the floor, sliding gracefully off.

entries.title: Mic Stand Assault
entries.text: The subject grabs an invisible mic stand, swings it dramatically, catches it, drops it, kicks it, picks it up again, does a full Pete Townshend smash motion, checks if it survived with concern.

entries.title: Skanking Spiral
entries.text: The subject skanks in ska style, pumping elbows and knees, moving faster and faster in tighter circles, a spinning dervish of plaid and elbows, finally flying outward and rolling to a stop.

entries.title: Feedback Loop
entries.text: The subject holds an invisible guitar up to an invisible amp, reacting to building feedback with full body convulsions, shaking the guitar, losing control as the imaginary sonic wall overwhelms them.

entries.title: Crowd Kill
entries.text: The subject swings arms in huge arcs through invisible crowd members, spinning with each hit, fighting the phantom crowd back, losing footing, sinking into the imaginary bodies around them.

entries.title: Neck Snap Loop
entries.text: The subject headbangs so violently their head seems to follow a different trajectory than the body, neck snapping forward and back, head circling, body trying to keep up, both going in separate directions.

entries.title: Stage Monitor Dive
entries.text: The subject runs toward invisible stage monitors, steps onto them, strikes a power pose facing the imaginary crowd, leans dangerously forward, tumbles off the front, bounces up playing air guitar.

entries.title: Oi Stomp
entries.text: The subject marches in place stomping with both feet alternately, pumping one fist, shouting at the ceiling, stomping faster, the whole body bouncing vertically until they've stomped themselves into the ground.

entries.title: Amp Stack Climb
entries.text: The subject climbs an invisible amp stack, placing hands and feet carefully, reaching the top, standing triumphantly with arms spread, swaying dangerously in the wind up there, slowly tipping backward.

categories.title: Absurd & Surreal
categories.description: Physics defiance · Logic collapse · Existential choreography

entries.title: Robot Malfunction
entries.text: The subject does jerky robot dance moves that glitch and break down, stiff mechanical movements becoming chaotic spasms, freezing mid-pose then restarting erratically with a different corrupted routine.

entries.title: Existential Disco
entries.text: The subject performs exaggerated disco moves alone, pointing dramatically at the sky then floor, doing wobbly hip thrusts, spinning with eyes half-closed in drunken existential ecstasy.

entries.title: Marionette Strings
entries.text: The subject moves as if controlled by invisible puppet strings, limbs jerking upward randomly, head lolling, walking in disconnected steps, collapsing entirely when the strings are cut.

entries.title: Slow Motion Fight
entries.text: The subject fights invisible enemies in extreme slow motion, throwing punches that take forever, dodging in long arcs, getting hit and falling dramatically slow, rising equally slowly to fight on.

entries.title: Invisible Limbo
entries.text: The subject does limbo under increasingly lower invisible bars, bending backward impossibly far, wobbling, crashing through the bar each time, lowering it and trying again with absolute determination.

entries.title: Tai Chi Drunk
entries.text: The subject performs extremely slow tai chi, movements becoming slower and slower, freezing mid-gesture for long beats, swaying, nearly falling, continuing in ultra slow motion with deep concentration.

entries.title: Mime Escape
entries.text: The subject desperately tries to escape an invisible box, pushing against walls that won't give, climbing, sliding down, panicking, finding a corner to squeeze through triumphantly into open space.

entries.title: Gravity Shifts
entries.text: The subject reacts to gravity shifting randomly, leaning hard left, stumbling right, pressing down against the ground, floating upward slightly, completely disoriented by physics failing.

entries.title: Time Loop
entries.text: The subject does a simple dance move, glitches, rewinds to starting position, does the same move slightly different, glitches again, stuck in a repeating loop with small variations each cycle.

entries.title: Victory Lap
entries.text: The subject runs in small circles with arms raised triumphantly, then breaks into chaotic celebratory dance, jumping, fist pumping, falling to knees, getting up dancing even harder than before.

entries.title: Magnetic Pull
entries.text: The subject is pulled by invisible magnetic forces from multiple directions, body stretching toward an invisible point, snapping to a new direction, being dragged sideways, pulled upward, fighting the pull.

entries.title: Echo Dance
entries.text: The subject makes a movement, then their body seems to echo it a half-second later, every gesture delayed and replayed, creating an uncanny self-following effect as they move through the space.

entries.title: Underwater Slow
entries.text: The subject moves as if submerged in invisible water, arms pushing through thick resistance, hair floating in slow arcs, turning in long languid circles, fighting the current, drifting helplessly.

entries.title: Invisible Wind
entries.text: The subject is blown by invisible gusts, leaning hard into the phantom wind, hair and clothes whipping dramatically, stumbling forward then pushed back, spinning in miniature tornado, anchoring to a post.

entries.title: Shadow Fight
entries.text: The subject battles their own shadow, throwing punches at it, jumping away from it, trying to stomp on it, furious when it keeps replicating the movements, finally surrendering to the shadow.

entries.title: Shrinking Space
entries.text: The subject dances normally then the invisible room starts shrinking, movements becoming smaller and more cramped, arms pressed inward, steps tiny, finally crouched in a micro-dance in invisible phone-booth size.

entries.title: Body Parts Revolt
entries.text: The subject's left arm dances differently from the right, legs going in opposite directions, head nodding counter to the beat, each body part following its own music, the entire figure in internal civil war.

entries.title: Static Charge
entries.text: The subject builds up invisible static electricity, hair rising, fingertips sparking imaginary bolts, body stiffening, jerking with each discharge, being launched sideways by phantom electric shocks.

entries.title: Floor is Lava
entries.text: The subject panics as the floor becomes invisible lava, hopping frantically between safe spots, leaping impossibly far to safe patches, wobbling on one foot, diving onto an invisible couch for safety.

entries.title: Double Speed Glitch
entries.text: The subject alternates between normal speed and double speed randomly within a single continuous dance, every few seconds snapping between fast and slow, body lurching with each speed transition.

entries.title: The Twist Malfunction
entries.text: The subject twists enthusiastically, hips rotating, arms pumping, sinking lower and lower doing the Twist, unable to stop descending, eventually twisting at floor level, trying to twist back up without success.

entries.title: Jive Gone Wild
entries.text: The subject jives with invisible partner, throwing them out on the arm, spinning them, pulling them back too hard, stumbling from the return force, both invisible partner and subject colliding catastrophically.

entries.title: Disco Pointing Crisis
entries.text: The subject does Saturday Night Fever pointing, first at sky, then floor, then sideways, getting confused about which direction is correct, pointing everywhere simultaneously, spinning in existential disco panic.

entries.title: Lindy Hop Disaster
entries.text: The subject does Lindy Hop solo, executing air steps with no partner, launching into aerial moves, landing badly, rolling across the floor, bouncing up into another aerial that sends them skidding away.

entries.title: Mashed Potato
entries.text: The subject does the Mashed Potato shuffle, feet dragging and stamping, getting progressively more vigorous, both feet leaving the ground simultaneously, landing askew, shuffling even harder with defiant energy.

entries.title: Hustle Overdrive
entries.text: The subject does the Hustle in slow motion, then normal speed, then double, caught in a speed loop, alternating wildly between tempos, arms and legs refusing to agree on which version they're performing.

entries.title: Charleston Chaos
entries.text: The subject does Charleston kicks, knees crossing and uncrossing rhythmically, kicking speed accelerating, kicks getting higher, legs crossing so fast they tangle, the subject hopping on one foot in confusion.

entries.title: Boogie Woogie Breakdown
entries.text: The subject busts out boogie woogie footwork, feet shuffling in complex patterns too fast to follow, losing the beat, feet moving independently of each other, creating accidental tap rhythms.

entries.title: Hitchhiker Loop
entries.text: The subject does the Hitchhiker move, thumb jabbing left, then right, then back, getting confused about which direction they're hitchhiking to, jabbing in all directions simultaneously in existential transport panic.

entries.title: Pony Gallop
entries.text: The subject does the Pony dance, galloping in place, galloping forward, galloping in circles, accelerating to a full sprint gallop, veering off-course, crashing through invisible furniture, galloping on.

entries.title: Hand Jive Convulsion
entries.text: The subject does elaborate hand jive patterns, slapping, crossing, pointing in sequence, the sequence speeding up until hands are a blur, then forgetting the next step and improvising wildly.

entries.title: The Frug Shrug
entries.text: The subject does the Frug, shimmying shoulders intensely, shaking head, the shake spreading down the body, entire torso vibrating, knees buckling, the full-body shimmy becoming uncontrollable.

entries.title: Watusi Wobble
entries.text: The subject does the Watusi, arms raising and lowering on alternating sides, hips swaying, the movement getting more and more exaggerated, arms reaching ceiling height, hips swinging like a pendulum.

entries.title: Locomotion Derail
entries.text: The subject does the Locomotion in a line with invisible people, pumping arms like a train, the locomotive gaining speed, derailing at a curve, cars piling up, climbing back on the invisible track.

entries.title: Swim Sink
entries.text: The subject does the Swim dance, doing freestyle stroke arms, breaststroke, butterfly, then sinking in slow motion through invisible water, still swimming as they descend, reaching the bottom, swimming along the floor.

entries.title: Freddie Flail
entries.text: The subject does the Freddie dance, jumping and swinging arms forward and back alternately, jumping getting higher, arms swinging wider, taking off briefly before a spectacular crash landing with arms still going.

entries.title: Funky Chicken Crisis
entries.text: The subject does the Funky Chicken, elbows flapping wildly, knees bending, becoming more and more aggressive, actual chicken noises implied, running around pecking the ground, completely committed to the bit.

entries.title: Robot Retro Crash
entries.text: The subject does precision 1970s Robot dance, locking perfectly, pointing mechanically, each joint moving independently, then the mechanisms fail one by one, each limb locking permanently until frozen mid-pose.

entries.title: Bump Collision
entries.text: The subject does the Bump dance, repeatedly hip-bumping an invisible partner, each bump sending both sideways, recovering, bumping again harder, getting bounced further each time, caroming across the floor.

entries.title: YMCA Architecture
entries.text: The subject constructs the YMCA letters with arms, getting the Y right, the M slightly wrong, the C backwards, the A completely confused, arms flailing trying every combination, crowd-pleasing incompetence.

categories.title: Club & Electronic

entries.title: Bass Drop Collapse
entries.text: The subject anticipates an invisible bass drop, building tension, crouching lower and lower, the drop hits, they explode upward with arms spread, the shockwave sending them stumbling backward across the floor.

entries.title: Melbourne Shuffle Gone
entries.text: The subject shuffles in Melbourne Shuffle style, feet sliding in T-step patterns, getting faster, both feet sliding in opposite directions simultaneously, doing full splits by accident, shuffling from floor level.

entries.title: Techno Trance State
entries.text: The subject enters a techno trance, bouncing mechanically on both feet, arms rigid at sides, eyes closed, head slightly down, completely robotic, suddenly snapping out of it confused, then immediately returning.

entries.title: Glowstick Phantom
entries.text: The subject waves invisible glowsticks in elaborate rave patterns, hands tracing glowing figure eights, the invisible sticks getting longer and more elaborate, wrapping around the body, tangling, escaping.

entries.title: DJ Drop Moment
entries.text: The subject celebrates as if the DJ just dropped their favorite track, losing their mind completely, grabbing nearby people who aren't there, screaming silently, jumping on invisible strangers, pure euphoria.

entries.title: Hardstyle Kick
entries.text: The subject does hardstyle kicks, one leg punching forward on each beat, gaining force with each kick, the kicks sending them backward, recovering, kicking harder, propelling across the space in one direction.

entries.title: Poi Spin Collapse
entries.text: The subject spins invisible poi, arms windmilling in circles, the invisible balls gaining speed, one arm going faster than the other, both spiraling out of sync, the subject tangling in phantom poi chains.

entries.title: PLUR Overload
entries.text: The subject performs rave handshakes with invisible ravers, trading invisible kandi, each trade getting more elaborate, arms gesturing peace-love-unity-respect, getting overwhelmed by invisible kandi bracelets.

entries.title: Four-on-the-Floor
entries.text: The subject marches to an invisible four-to-the-floor techno beat, perfectly on time for three counts, adding body rolls that throw off the timing, trying to find the beat again, marching way off-tempo with confidence.

entries.title: Hands Up Anthem
entries.text: The subject throws both hands up as the anthem hits, holding them high triumphantly, arms getting tired, lowering slightly, trying to put them back up, arms too heavy now, standing with hands at half-mast.

entries.title: Dubstep Convulsion
entries.text: The subject dances smoothly to invisible music, the beat drops to dubstep wobble, entire body convulsing with each wobble sound, limbs jerking robotically, expression of surprise and surrender to the wub.

entries.title: Laser Show React
entries.text: The subject reacts to invisible laser lights sweeping the room, ducking under beams, reaching up to touch them, being blinded by a direct hit, stumbling, following laser patterns across the floor and ceiling.

entries.title: Strobe Freeze
entries.text: The subject moves in perfect synchrony with invisible strobe lights, appearing to freeze and jump between positions, moving in staccato bursts of motion, confused when the strobe stops, trying to recreate the effect alone.

entries.title: Smoke Machine Panic
entries.text: The subject gets engulfed in invisible smoke machine fog, dancing blindly, bumping into invisible people, losing orientation completely, swimming through the fog, emerging on the wrong side of the dancefloor.

entries.title: Subwoofer Resonance
entries.text: The subject stands near invisible subwoofers, the bass physically shaking their body, clothes rippling, cheeks vibrating, entire skeleton resonating, being gradually pushed backward by phantom low-frequency pressure.

entries.title: VIP Rope Confusion
entries.text: The subject dances their way toward an invisible VIP rope, smooth-talking the invisible bouncer, getting rejected, arguing, being let in, immediately getting lost in the invisible VIP area, dancing alone in wrong section.

entries.title: BPM Escalation
entries.text: The subject dances at normal tempo, the invisible BPM rising, movements getting faster, switching from house to techno to gabber speeds, moving at physically impossible speed, heart exploding, collapsing in heap.

entries.title: Phone Torch Wave
entries.text: The subject waves an invisible phone torch in the air during the emotional moment, swaying with eyes closed, lowering it to check the screen, texting someone about how good this is, torch back up, pure devotion.

entries.title: After-Party Zombie
entries.text: The subject dances on pure muscle memory at 6am, eyes barely open, movements slowing to quarter speed, still bouncing mechanically, nodding off mid-bounce, jerking awake, nodding off again, still dancing.

entries.title: Water Bottle Ritual
entries.text: The subject dances while dramatically drinking from an invisible water bottle, spilling it on themselves, continuing to dance while dripping, refilling from nowhere, offering it to invisible strangers, emptying it on their head.

categories.title: World Traditions
categories.description: Folk disasters · Ritual collapses · Cultural meltdowns

entries.title: Cossack Crouch
entries.text: The subject attempts Cossack kick-dance, squatting low and kicking legs forward alternately, getting too low, legs not strong enough to kick, toppling backward from squat position, still attempting kicks from the ground.

entries.title: Bollywood Arms
entries.text: The subject performs expressive Bollywood mudra arm gestures, each hand telling a different story, expressions shifting from joy to sorrow to surprise, the narrative getting so dramatic they fall to their knees weeping.

entries.title: Irish Reel Reel
entries.text: The subject performs rigid-armed Irish step dance, feet moving in precise reel patterns, arms locked at sides, face expressionless, feet getting faster and more chaotic while upper body maintains perfect noble stillness.

entries.title: Belly Roll Breakdown
entries.text: The subject attempts belly dance undulations, rolling the torso in waves, the wave getting stuck at the ribcage, trying to push it through, body convulsing, the wave finally breaking free and traveling too far upward.

entries.title: Haka Gone Wrong
entries.text: The subject performs an intense solo haka, stomping, sticking tongue out dramatically, eyes wide, slapping thighs, the intensity escalating until they're screaming at invisible opponents, collapsing from sheer ferocity.

entries.title: Samba Spiral
entries.text: The subject samba steps with exaggerated hip sways, hips rotating in enormous circles, the rotation gaining momentum, entire lower body orbiting, upper body trying to compensate, spinning around their own hips.

entries.title: Greek Circle Solo
entries.text: The subject does sirtaki solo, the Zorba the Greek circle dance alone, picking up speed with each circuit, arms spread wide, kicking higher, the circle getting faster until reaching a full sprint around nothing.

entries.title: Dervish Spin
entries.text: The subject spins as a Sufi whirling dervish, one arm up one arm down, spinning, spinning, the spiritual bliss becoming vertigo, the spinning going wrong, staggering sideways, still reaching transcendence mid-stumble.

entries.title: Dragon Boat Crew
entries.text: The subject paddles furiously in an invisible dragon boat, powerful synchronized strokes, the boat veering sideways, paddling harder on one side, overcorrecting, the phantom boat spinning in circles.

entries.title: Macarena Sequence Loss
entries.text: The subject starts the Macarena perfectly, right arm, left arm, right hip tap — losing the sequence, doing arms in wrong order, adding moves that aren't in the song, inventing a new Macarena with confidence.

entries.title: Capoeira Shadow
entries.text: The subject performs capoeira ginga with invisible partner, flowing in and out of combat range, executing kicks that miss by feet, cartwheel au that sends them rolling, getting back into ginga seamlessly.

entries.title: Tinikling Phantom
entries.text: The subject hops between invisible bamboo poles being clapped together, feet moving fast, catching an invisible pole, hopping over the phantom clap, timing getting worse, feet getting symbolically trapped.

entries.title: Line Dance Tangent
entries.text: The subject line dances in perfect step, grapevine right, kick-ball-change, turn — facing wrong direction, continuing confidently in wrong direction, executing steps perfectly while the invisible line goes the other way.

entries.title: Hora Hurricane
entries.text: The subject dances the Hora in a solo circle, hopping and kicking in the Israeli folk pattern, the circle getting tighter and faster, a miniature tornado, centrifugal force eventually launching them outward.

entries.title: Cumbia Catastrophe
entries.text: The subject does cumbia with partner hold position to nobody, hip sways and forward-backward footwork, leading invisible partner off the floor, apologizing to stepped-on invisible toes, continuing with deep regret.

entries.title: Tarantella Sting
entries.text: The subject performs the Italian tarantella, spinning frantically as if bitten by a spider, the cure being continuous dancing, getting more frantic, the venom seemingly winning, spinning on the floor, still going.

entries.title: Riverdance Malfunction
entries.text: The subject stomps in Riverdance style, perfectly rigid arms, high knees, feet hammering — face breaking into grin, arms escaping their rigid position, the entire Riverdance discipline crumbling into chaos.

entries.title: Floss Ancient
entries.text: The subject flosses with archaeological seriousness, explaining to nobody that this ancient ritual dance form carries deep cultural meaning, performing it with solemn gravity as arms swing and hips counter-swing.

entries.title: Kecak Choir Solo
entries.text: The subject performs solo kecak, making chak-chak-chak sounds, raised arms trembling like the Balinese fire dance chorus of one, narrating the Ramayana to themselves, voices and gestures multiplying impossibly.

entries.title: Gangnam Escape
entries.text: The subject does Gangnam Style invisible horse riding, bouncing on the invisible horse, the horse getting out of control, the subject clinging on, being thrown, landing badly, remounting, galloping into the distance.

entries.title: Action Hero Landing
entries.text: The subject lands from a great height in a superhero three-point pose, cracks in the floor spreading from the impact, slowly rising with jacket billowing in invisible wind, immediately stumbling forward.

entries.title: Musical Number Regret
entries.text: The subject launches into a full show-tune production number, jazz hands, high kicks, big vocal arms — stopping to look around embarrassed, then launching back in with even more commitment than before.

entries.title: Slow Motion Run
entries.text: The subject runs toward camera in dramatic Baywatch slow-motion, hair bouncing, confident smile, hitting a divot, slowly tipping forward, the slow-motion fall taking forever, landing with slow-motion face plant.

entries.title: Training Montage
entries.text: The subject cycles through rapid-fire training montage poses — boxing, pull-ups, running in place — transitioning too fast, getting poses mixed up, boxing while doing pull-up arms, running while punching the air.

entries.title: Western Showdown
entries.text: The subject faces off at high noon, hand hovering over invisible holster, the world's slowest draw, finally pulling an invisible gun, discovering both hands reached for the same holster, reconsidering everything.

entries.title: Horror Retreat
entries.text: The subject backs away from invisible horror, stumbling over nothing, looking behind them while moving forward into another danger, the classic horror backing-away-and-falling-into-danger choreography.

entries.title: Sci-Fi Zero-G
entries.text: The subject floats in zero gravity, pushing off invisible walls, spinning slowly end over end, reaching for objects drifting past, completely unable to control trajectory, tumbling through invisible space station.

entries.title: Kung Fu Drunk Master
entries.text: The subject staggers forward in Drunken Fist style, stumbling becoming combat moves, falling turning into sweeps, the entire drunk walk being perfect martial arts form that defeats invisible attackers.

entries.title: Thriller Zombie
entries.text: The subject does Michael Jackson's Thriller zombie dance, arms extended, shuffling, then getting confused about which way the zombie line is going, shuffling toward camera, toward the audience, choosing chaos.

entries.title: Karate Kid Crane
entries.text: The subject strikes the crane pose on one leg, holding it with intense focus, wobbling, correcting, wobbling worse, arms spreading for balance, the other foot touching down repeatedly, crane refusing to stay.

entries.title: Matrix Dodge
entries.text: The subject dodges invisible bullets in slow motion, bending backward impossibly, time slowing around them, snapping back up, dodging left, right, completely losing orientation, matrix-running in wrong direction.

entries.title: Dirty Dancing Lift
entries.text: The subject runs toward invisible partner for the famous lift, partner not there, running through the space alone, arms spread dramatically, executing the lift alone held aloft by sheer belief, held triumphantly.

entries.title: Footloose Fence
entries.text: The subject performs the Footloose angry barn dance sequence, kicking and spinning in an empty space, the full teenage angst energy, performing for nobody, getting increasingly committed to the solo rebellion.

entries.title: Samurai Ready Stance
entries.text: The subject draws invisible katana from invisible scabbard in slow dramatic pull, holds warrior stance, the drawn-out wait for the invisible opponent, losing focus, checking if opponent is still there, resheathing to start over.

entries.title: Rocky Staircase
entries.text: The subject runs up invisible stairs triumphantly, arms pumping, cresting the top, doing the Rocky victory dance, raising fists, then realizing they're at street level, still doing the victory dance anyway.

entries.title: Wuxia Wire Fall
entries.text: The subject fights enemies while being lifted on invisible wire, running on invisible walls, floating mid-kick, the wire going slack suddenly, dropping unexpectedly, the wire pulling them sideways mid-speech.

entries.title: Risky Business Slide
entries.text: The subject slides across invisible floor in socks, arms spread for balance, gliding further than intended, hitting an invisible wall at speed, bouncing back, executing the lip-sync dance routine regardless.

entries.title: Villain Monologue Sway
entries.text: The subject delivers a silent villain monologue with dramatic gestures, pacing dramatically, stopping to make the key point, stumbling over invisible cat, recovering composure, the moment somewhat ruined, continuing anyway.

entries.title: Bollywood Chase
entries.text: The subject runs from invisible Bollywood villain, ducking, hiding behind invisible pillars, peeking out, running again, the chase suddenly becoming a spontaneous choreographed number mid-escape, villain joining in.

entries.title: Final Boss Dance-Off
entries.text: The subject faces off against invisible final boss in decisive dance battle, opening move destroyed by boss counter, escalating moves, the subject hitting their absolute best combination, waiting for the boss's verdict.
